name: no-ai-slop
description: Removes 20+ patterns of AI slop from any piece of writing.

interface.longDescription:
This plugin removes 20+ patterns of AI slop from your writing without flattening your personal voice. It can also detect slop without guessing whether AI wrote the text.

It catches patterns like binary contrasts, throat-clearing openers, faux-insight setups, superficial analysis, importance puffery, weasel attribution, synonym cycling, and dramatic fragmentation. It also checks the fundamentals: lead with the point when it helps, use active voice, untangle hard-to-follow sentences, and prefer concrete numbers over abstractions.
